title: The welcome email cannot go out twice for one member

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: sendWelcomeEmail (lib/email.ts:234-258) queues with no dedupeKey although the outbox supports one, and writeInduction runs from both completeInduction and finalizePendingInduction (app/join/(induction)/actions.ts:512,728). A double submit or a finalize after a complete sends the welcome twice. Fix: dedupeKey welcome:<profile id>.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
